subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new public `MemoryRerankProvider` SDK seam with a `memoryRerankProviders` manifest contract, exclusive single-provider slot, and builtin-only rerank scope?
rationale: This is a new plugin contract and product extension point, so green tests cannot decide whether the API shape and ownership model should become a shipped third-party plugin surface.

options.title: Approve seam as v1
options.body: Accept this public SDK contract after conflict resolution and require final memory-core, plugin-contract, tsgo, and docs proof on the rebased head.

options.title: Revise API shape first
options.body: Request a different capability declaration, provider-selection model, or QMD parity plan before publishing the contract.

options.title: Defer behind RFC
options.body: Keep the PR parked or close it until the linked rerank RFC settles the product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve seam as v1
recommendation.body: Accept this public SDK contract after conflict resolution and require final memory-core, plugin-contract, tsgo, and docs proof on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin SDK, registry, docs, and memory reliability history make this the strongest available routing signal for the API decision.
